fact: For n > 7, a(n) = 11*a(n-3)-10*a(n-6). For n > 4, a(n-3) + 3*10^(floor((n-1)/3)). For n > 1, (2*10^(floor((n+2)/3))+(63*m^2-129*m-2))/6, where m is the least nonnegative residue of n mod 3. - _Chai Wah Wu_, Dec 11 2015
